title: 吉隆坡雙子星塔
summary: 從核心筒與周邊柱環的側力分工、以混凝土重量換取低加速度出發，計算高強度混凝土圓柱的容量與空橋支腳的轉角，再處理避開石灰岩懸崖的塔位移動與深樁筏基、兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制、高強度混凝土驗收與雙塔風洞干擾，最後是熱帶氣候下的外牆維護與空橋作為避難路徑的交接。
summaryEn: Starting from lateral load sharing between the core and the perimeter column ring and from trading concrete weight for low acceleration, compute the capacity of high-strength concrete columns and the rotation of the skybridge legs, then handle the site shift away from a limestone cliff onto deep piles and rafts, geometry control with two contractors working in parallel, high-strength concrete acceptance and twin-tower wind interference, ending with façade upkeep in a tropical climate and the handover of the skybridge as an escape route.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 筏基連續澆置練習：某塔筏基約 13,200 m³，要求連續澆置不留冷縫。若配置 4 部泵車、每部名目 80 m³/h、效率 75%，實際供料 4×80×0.75 = 240 m³/h，約需 13,200/240 = 55 小時；以 8 m³ 的預拌車計，每小時約需 240/8 = 30 車。若筏基面積約 2,900 m²、分層厚 0.5 m，每層約 1,450 m³，需 1,450/240 ≈ 6.0 小時才能覆蓋整層；混凝土初凝時間若為 6 小時，已無餘裕。一部泵車故障使供料降為 180 m³/h 時，每層需約 8.1 小時、總時數增為約 73 小時，下層會在被覆蓋前初凝而形成冷縫，因此必須改用斜坡分層以縮小外露面積、加緩凝劑或預備備用泵。數值為教學假設，不代表雙子星塔的實際施工。
workedExample.textEn: Continuous raft pour: a tower raft of about 13,200 m³ must be placed without cold joints. With 4 pumps of 80 m³/h nominal at 75% efficiency, actual supply is 4×80×0.75 = 240 m³/h, needing about 13,200/240 = 55 hours and, with 8 m³ trucks, about 240/8 = 30 trucks per hour. If the raft is about 2,900 m² and placed in 0.5 m layers, each layer is about 1,450 m³ and takes 1,450/240 ≈ 6.0 hours to cover; with an initial set of 6 hours there is no margin. If one pump breaks down and supply falls to 180 m³/h, each layer takes about 8.1 hours and the total about 73 hours, so the layer below sets before it is covered and forms a cold joint; the plan must therefore use sloped layering to shrink the exposed face, add retarder or keep a standby pump. Values are teaching assumptions, not the actual Petronas operation.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高強度混凝土管中管的側力分工」與「以重量換取低加速度」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 高強度混凝土管中管的側力分工：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lateral load sharing in a high-strength concrete tube-in-tube: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「核心筒與周邊柱環」如何影響吉隆坡雙子星塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Core and perimeter column ring” governs force, deformation or durability in “Petronas Twin Towers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙子星塔每座塔以約 23 m × 23 m 的鋼筋混凝土核心筒，加上一圈間距較大的圓形超級柱組成「管中管」系統，周邊柱以環梁連成框架筒，兩者經樓板共同抵抗側力。核心筒提供大部分剪力勁度，周邊框架筒則以較大的力臂提供抗傾覆能力；框架筒的效率取決於環梁勁度，環梁越柔，翼面柱子的軸力越受剪力滯後影響而無法充分發揮。選擇混凝土而非鋼構，部分原因是當時鋼材需進口、成本高，而高強度混凝土是在地承包商熟悉的材料。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「核心筒與周邊柱環」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each Petronas tower combines a reinforced concrete core of about 23 m × 23 m with a ring of widely spaced circular super columns in a tube-in-tube system; ring beams link the perimeter columns into a framed tube, and floors make the two work together against lateral load. The core supplies most of the shear stiffness while the perimeter tube, with its larger lever arm, supplies overturning resistance; the tube's efficiency depends on ring-beam stiffness, because flexible ring beams let shear lag keep flange columns from developing their full axial share. Concrete rather than steel was chosen partly because steel then had to be imported at high cost, while high-strength concrete was familiar to local contractors. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Core and perimeter column ring” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：有效慣性矩比較：核心 23 m 見方、牆厚 0.75 m，I_core = (23⁴ − 21.5⁴)/12 ≈ 5,514 m⁴；16 支直徑 2.4 m 圓柱位於半徑 22 m 圓周，完全共同作用時 I = A·n·R²/2 = 4.52×16×22²/2 ≈ 17,500 m⁴，若環梁柔度使效率 η = 0.3，有效 I ≈ 5,250 m⁴，周邊分擔約 49%；η = 0.5 時約 61%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Effective inertia comparison: a 23 m square core with 0.75 m walls has I_core = (23⁴ − 21.5⁴)/12 ≈ 5,514 m⁴; 16 columns of 2.4 m diameter on a 22 m radius would give I = A·n·R²/2 = 4.52×16×22²/2 ≈ 17,500 m⁴ if fully composite, but with ring-beam flexibility limiting efficiency to η = 0.3 the effective I is about 5,250 m⁴ and the perimeter share about 49%, rising to about 61% at η = 0.5.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「管中管系統中，外圈柱只負責重力，側力全由核心承擔。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "In a tube-in-tube system the outer columns carry only gravity and the core takes all lateral load." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「核心筒與周邊柱環」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Core and perimeter column ring”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 高強度混凝土管中管的側力分工：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lateral load sharing in a high-strength concrete tube-in-tube: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「核心筒與周邊柱環」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Core and perimeter column ring” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：有效慣性矩比較：核心 23 m 見方、牆厚 0.75 m，I_core = (23⁴ − 21.5⁴)/12 ≈ 5,514 m⁴；16 支直徑 2.4 m 圓柱位於半徑 22 m 圓周，完全共同作用時 I = A·n·R²/2 = 4.52×16×22²/2 ≈ 17,500 m⁴，若環梁柔度使效率 η = 0.3，有效 I ≈ 5,250 m⁴，周邊分擔約 49%；η = 0.5 時約 61%。柱數與尺寸為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Effective inertia comparison: a 23 m square core with 0.75 m walls has I_core = (23⁴ − 21.5⁴)/12 ≈ 5,514 m⁴; 16 columns of 2.4 m diameter on a 22 m radius would give I = A·n·R²/2 = 4.52×16×22²/2 ≈ 17,500 m⁴ if fully composite, but with ring-beam flexibility limiting efficiency to η = 0.3 the effective I is about 5,250 m⁴ and the perimeter share about 49%, rising to about 61% at η = 0.5. Column count and size are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在三維模型中改變環梁斷面，輸出周邊框架筒分擔的傾覆彎矩與柱軸力分布，確認翼面中央柱與角部柱的軸力比（剪力滯後程度）；再把混凝土開裂後的有效勁度折減納入，比較頂層變位與週期是否仍符合要求。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Vary ring-beam sections in the three-dimensional model, output the overturning share of the perimeter tube and the distribution of column axial forces, and confirm the axial ratio between mid-flange and corner columns, which measures shear lag; then include cracked-section stiffness reductions and check that top drift and period still meet the requirements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 高強度混凝土管中管的側力分工：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lateral load sharing in a high-strength concrete tube-in-tube: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「核心筒與周邊柱環」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Core and perimeter column ring” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在三維模型中改變環梁斷面，輸出周邊框架筒分擔的傾覆彎矩與柱軸力分布，確認翼面中央柱與角部柱的軸力比（剪力滯後程度）；再把混凝土開裂後的有效勁度折減納入，比較頂層變位與週期是否仍符合要求。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Vary ring-beam sections in the three-dimensional model, output the overturning share of the perimeter tube and the distribution of column axial forces, and confirm the axial ratio between mid-flange and corner columns, which measures shear lag; then include cracked-section stiffness reductions and check that top drift and period still meet the requirements. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：環梁的開孔、續接與配筋列為結構關鍵項目，機電穿孔必須在設計階段定位並補強，施工中任何新增開孔都需結構工程師書面同意。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Treat ring-beam openings, splices and reinforcement as critical structural items; locate and reinforce service penetrations at the design stage, and require the structural engineer's written approval for any new opening during construction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若環梁在設計中被當成剛接而實際開裂後勁度大減，周邊框架筒的貢獻被高估，核心筒承受的彎矩與變位都會超過預期；管線為穿越環梁而開大孔，也會削弱框架筒的作用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If ring beams are modelled as rigid but lose much of their stiffness once cracked, the perimeter tube's contribution is overestimated and the core sees more moment and drift than expected; large service openings cut through ring beams also weaken the framed-tube action. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在三維模型中改變環梁斷面，輸出周邊框架筒分擔的傾覆彎矩與柱軸力分布，確認翼面中央柱與角部柱的軸力比（剪力滯後程度）；再把混凝土開裂後的有效勁度折減納入，比較頂層變位與週期是否仍符合要求。
knowledge.textEn: Vary ring-beam sections in the three-dimensional model, output the overturning share of the perimeter tube and the distribution of column axial forces, and confirm the axial ratio between mid-flange and corner columns, which measures shear lag; then include cracked-section stiffness reductions and check that top drift and period still meet the requirements.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 環梁的開孔、續接與配筋列為結構關鍵項目，機電穿孔必須在設計階段定位並補強，施工中任何新增開孔都需結構工程師書面同意。
knowledge.textEn: Treat ring-beam openings, splices and reinforcement as critical structural items; locate and reinforce service penetrations at the design stage, and require the structural engineer's written approval for any new opening during construction.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高強度混凝土管中管的側力分工：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lateral load sharing in a high-strength concrete tube-in-tube: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「核心筒與周邊柱環」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Core and perimeter column ring” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若環梁在設計中被當成剛接而實際開裂後勁度大減，周邊框架筒的貢獻被高估，核心筒承受的彎矩與變位都會超過預期；管線為穿越環梁而開大孔，也會削弱框架筒的作用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If ring beams are modelled as rigid but lose much of their stiffness once cracked, the perimeter tube's contribution is overestimated and the core sees more moment and drift than expected; large service openings cut through ring beams also weaken the framed-tube action. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：選擇混凝土而非鋼構，部分原因是當時鋼材需進口、成本高，而高強度混凝土是在地承包商熟悉的材料。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Concrete rather than steel was chosen partly because steel then had to be imported at high cost, while high-strength concrete was familiar to local contractors.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「管中管系統中，外圈柱只負責重力，側力全由核心承擔。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "In a tube-in-tube system the outer columns carry only gravity and the core takes all lateral load." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「高強度混凝土管中管的側力分工」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lateral load sharing in a high-strength concrete tube-in-tube" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 以重量換取低加速度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Trading weight for low acceleration: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「混凝土質量與風振」如何影響吉隆坡雙子星塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concrete mass and wind sway” governs force, deformation or durability in “Petronas Twin Towers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 公開資料指出，高強度混凝土在降低擺動上的效果約為鋼材的兩倍，但也讓建築約重一倍；建築師的資料記載每座塔約重 300,000 公噸。對風致振動而言，加速度與參與振動的質量成反比，而混凝土結構的固有阻尼通常也比鋼構略高，兩者都讓居住者感受到的晃動減少。代價是基礎必須承受更大的重力，地震時的慣性力也隨質量增加，因此重量帶來的好處只在風控制設計時成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「混凝土質量與風振」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Public sources note that high-strength concrete is about twice as effective as steel in reducing sway but makes the building about twice as heavy; the architect's figures give each tower a weight of about 300,000 t. For wind-induced vibration, acceleration is inversely proportional to the participating mass, and concrete structures usually have slightly higher inherent damping than steel, both reducing the motion occupants feel. The price is heavier gravity loads on the foundations and larger inertia forces in earthquakes, so the benefit of weight holds only where wind governs the design. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Concrete mass and wind sway” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：相同風力頻譜下，共振加速度約與 1/(M·√ζ) 成正比。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Under the same wind-force spectrum, resonant acceleration is roughly proportional to 1/(M·√ζ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「建築越輕越好，重量對結構只有壞處。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The lighter a building the better; weight is always bad for a structure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「混凝土質量與風振」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Concrete mass and wind sway”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 以重量換取低加速度
knowledge.text: 公開資料指出，高強度混凝土在降低擺動上的效果約為鋼材的兩倍，但也讓建築約重一倍；建築師的資料記載每座塔約重 300,000 公噸。對風致振動而言，加速度與參與振動的質量成反比，而混凝土結構的固有阻尼通常也比鋼構略高，兩者都讓居住者感受到的晃動減少。
knowledge.textEn: Public sources note that high-strength concrete is about twice as effective as steel in reducing sway but makes the building about twice as heavy; the architect's figures give each tower a weight of about 300,000 t. For wind-induced vibration, acceleration is inversely proportional to the participating mass, and concrete structures usually have slightly higher inherent damping than steel, both reducing the motion occupants feel.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：建築越輕越好，重量對結構只有壞處。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The lighter a building the better; weight is always bad for a structure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「以重量換取低加速度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Trading weight for low acceleration" is correct?
options: 建築越輕越好，重量對結構只有壞處。
高強度混凝土比一般混凝土更有韌性，所以不需要額外圍束。
公開資料指出，高強度混凝土在降低擺動上的效果約為鋼材的兩倍，但也讓建築約重一倍；建築師的資料記載每座塔約重 300,000 公噸。
optionsEn: The lighter a building the better; weight is always bad for a structure.
High-strength concrete is tougher than ordinary concrete, so it needs no extra confinement.
Public sources note that high-strength concrete is about twice as effective as steel in reducing sway but makes the building about twice as heavy.
quiz.explanation: 公開資料指出，高強度混凝土在降低擺動上的效果約為鋼材的兩倍，但也讓建築約重一倍；建築師的資料記載每座塔約重 300,000 公噸。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Public sources note that high-strength concrete is about twice as effective as steel in reducing sway but makes the building about twice as heavy; the architect's figures give each tower a weight of about 300,000 t. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 以重量換取低加速度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Trading weight for low acceleration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「混凝土質量與風振」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Concrete mass and wind sway” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：相同風力頻譜下，共振加速度約與 1/(M·√ζ) 成正比。鋼構方案 M = 200,000 t、ζ = 1.5%，混凝土方案 M = 300,000 t、ζ = 2%：加速度比 = (200,000×√0.015)/(300,000×√0.02) ≈ 24,495/42,426 ≈ 0.58，即混凝土塔的加速度約為鋼構塔的 58%（未計週期差異）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Under the same wind-force spectrum, resonant acceleration is roughly proportional to 1/(M·√ζ). For a steel scheme with M = 200,000 t and ζ = 1.5% versus a concrete scheme with M = 300,000 t and ζ = 2%, the acceleration ratio is (200,000×√0.015)/(300,000×√0.02) ≈ 24,495/42,426 ≈ 0.58, so the concrete tower sees about 58% of the steel tower's acceleration, ignoring period differences. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以風洞力平衡或氣動彈性試驗取得兩種結構方案的頂層加速度，與居住性準則比較；完工後以環境振動量測實際頻率與阻尼比，確認設計假設的阻尼值不是過度樂觀。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain top-floor accelerations for both structural schemes from force-balance or aeroelastic wind-tunnel tests and compare them with habitability criteria; after completion measure the actual frequencies and damping by ambient vibration to confirm the assumed damping was not optimistic.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 相同風力頻譜下，共振加速度約與 1/(M·√ζ) 成正比。鋼構方案 M = 200,000 t、ζ = 1.5%，混凝土方案 M = 300,000 t、ζ = 2%：加速度比 = (200,000×√0.015)/(300,000×√0.02) ≈ 24,495/42,426 ≈ 0.58，即混凝土塔的加速度約為鋼構塔的 58%（未計週期差異）。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Under the same wind-force spectrum, resonant acceleration is roughly proportional to 1/(M·√ζ). For a steel scheme with M = 200,000 t and ζ = 1.5% versus a concrete scheme with M = 300,000 t and ζ = 2%, the acceleration ratio is (200,000×√0.015)/(300,000×√0.02) ≈ 24,495/42,426 ≈ 0.58, so the concrete tower sees about 58% of the steel tower's acceleration, ignoring period differences. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「以重量換取低加速度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Trading weight for low acceleration", which statement holds?
options: 相同風力頻譜下，共振加速度約與 1/(M·√ζ) 成正比。
只要把樁打得夠深，地質條件的差異就不重要。
只要大多數試體合格，偶爾幾組不合格可以忽略。
optionsEn: Under the same wind-force spectrum, resonant acceleration is roughly proportional to 1/(M·√ζ).
If piles are driven deep enough, differences in ground conditions do not matter.
If most specimens pass, an occasional failing set can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 相同風力頻譜下，共振加速度約與 1/(M·√ζ) 成正比。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Under the same wind-force spectrum, resonant acceleration is roughly proportional to 1/(M·√ζ). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 以重量換取低加速度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Trading weight for low acceleration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「混凝土質量與風振」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Concrete mass and wind sway” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以風洞力平衡或氣動彈性試驗取得兩種結構方案的頂層加速度，與居住性準則比較；完工後以環境振動量測實際頻率與阻尼比，確認設計假設的阻尼值不是過度樂觀。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain top-floor accelerations for both structural schemes from force-balance or aeroelastic wind-tunnel tests and compare them with habitability criteria; after completion measure the actual frequencies and damping by ambient vibration to confirm the assumed damping was not optimistic. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：結構方案比選時，應同時列出重量、基礎需求、風致加速度與地震力四項，讓業主看清取捨；阻尼假設要引用實測資料或文獻範圍，並在交接時提供實測值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When comparing structural schemes, tabulate weight, foundation demand, wind acceleration and seismic force together so the owner sees the trade-offs; base damping assumptions on measured data or published ranges, and hand over the measured values at completion.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若設計時把混凝土阻尼取得過高，而完工實測阻尼較低，強風時加速度可能超出舒適度門檻；增加的質量若未在基礎與地震分析中完整計入，會低估樁的承載需求與地震力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If concrete damping is assumed too high in design and the measured value proves lower, accelerations can exceed comfort limits in strong winds; if the added mass is not fully carried into the foundation and seismic analyses, pile demands and earthquake forces are underestimated. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以風洞力平衡或氣動彈性試驗取得兩種結構方案的頂層加速度，與居住性準則比較；完工後以環境振動量測實際頻率與阻尼比，確認設計假設的阻尼值不是過度樂觀。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain top-floor accelerations for both structural schemes from force-balance or aeroelastic wind-tunnel tests and compare them with habitability criteria; after completion measure the actual frequencies and damping by ambient vibration to confirm the assumed damping was not optimistic.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

steps.title: 高強度混凝土圓柱的軸壓容量：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Axial capacity of high-strength concrete columns: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「高強度混凝土圓柱」如何影響吉隆坡雙子星塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High-strength concrete circular columns” governs force, deformation or durability in “Petronas Twin Towers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙子星塔的周邊超級柱為圓形鋼筋混凝土柱，隨高度逐段縮小，以高強度混凝土承受每座塔約 300,000 公噸重量中的大部分。高強度混凝土讓柱斷面變小、可用樓地板增加，但材料較脆，需要較密的箍筋或螺旋筋提供圍束，才能在地震或意外超載時保有延性；其彈性模數、徐變與乾縮也與一般混凝土不同，影響柱與核心之間的差異縮短。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「高強度混凝土圓柱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Petronas perimeter super columns are circular reinforced concrete columns that step down in size with height, using high-strength concrete to carry most of each tower's roughly 300,000 t weight. High-strength concrete shrinks column sections and frees floor area, but it is more brittle and needs closely spaced ties or spirals for confinement to keep ductility in an earthquake or accidental overload; its elastic modulus, creep and shrinkage also differ from ordinary concrete, affecting differential shortening between columns and core. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “High-strength concrete circular columns” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：P₀ = 0.85·f'c·(A_g − A_st) + f_y·A_st。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: P₀ = 0.85·f'c·(A_g − A_st) + f_y·A_st.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「高強度混凝土比一般混凝土更有韌性，所以不需要額外圍束。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High-strength concrete is tougher than ordinary concrete, so it needs no extra confinement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「高強度混凝土圓柱」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “High-strength concrete circular columns”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高強度混凝土圓柱的軸壓容量

quiz.question: 關於「高強度混凝土圓柱的軸壓容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Axial capacity of high-strength concrete columns" is correct?

空橋把兩座塔連在一起，可以讓兩塔互相支撐、減少擺動。

steps.title: 高強度混凝土圓柱的軸壓容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Axial capacity of high-strength concrete columns: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高強度混凝土圓柱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “High-strength concrete circular columns” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：P₀ = 0.85·f'c·(A_g − A_st) + f_y·A_st。直徑 2.4 m：A_g ≈ 4.52 m²、ρ = 2% 時 A_st ≈ 0.090 m²；f'c = 80 MPa、f_y = 420 MPa，P₀ ≈ 301.5 + 38.0 ≈ 339.5 MN，最大設計軸力 0.80×0.65×P₀ ≈ 176.5 MN。若 f'c 只有 40 MPa，約 98.1 MN，柱數或斷面須增加約八成。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: P₀ = 0.85·f'c·(A_g − A_st) + f_y·A_st. For a 2.4 m diameter, A_g ≈ 4.52 m² and A_st ≈ 0.090 m² at ρ = 2%; with f'c = 80 MPa and f_y = 420 MPa, P₀ ≈ 301.5 + 38.0 ≈ 339.5 MN and the maximum design axial force is 0.80×0.65×P₀ ≈ 176.5 MN. With f'c of only 40 MPa it is about 98.1 MN, so columns or sections must grow by about 80%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以試拌確認高強度混凝土的強度、彈性模數與工作性，施工中依批次取試體；柱的螺旋筋間距與保護層以現場量測抽查，並在澆置前檢查鋼筋籠是否留有足夠的混凝土通道，避免低坍度的高強度混凝土無法填實。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm strength, elastic modulus and workability of the high-strength mix in trial batches and sample by batch during construction; spot-check spiral pitch and cover on site, and check before each pour that the cage leaves enough passage for the concrete so a stiff high-strength mix can still compact fully.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: P₀ = 0.85·f'c·(A_g − A_st) + f_y·A_st. For a 2.4 m diameter, A_g ≈ 4.52 m² and A_st ≈ 0.090 m² at ρ = 2%; with f'c = 80 MPa and f_y = 420 MPa, P₀ ≈ 301.5 + 38.0 ≈ 339.5 MN and the maximum design axial force is 0.80×0.65×P₀ ≈ 176.5 MN. With f'c of only 40 MPa it is about 98.1 MN, so columns or sections must grow by about 80%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高強度混凝土圓柱的軸壓容量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Axial capacity of high-strength concrete columns", which statement holds?

P₀ = 0.85·f'c·(A_g − A_st) + f_y·A_st。
兩座相同的塔在風中會同步擺動，所以空橋不需要容許相對位移。
optionsEn: If each tower is built plumb on its own, the skybridge will automatically fit.
P₀ = 0.85·f'c·(A_g − A_st) + f_y·A_st.
Two identical towers sway in step in the wind, so the skybridge needs no allowance for relative movement.

steps.title: 高強度混凝土圓柱的軸壓容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Axial capacity of high-strength concrete columns: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高強度混凝土圓柱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “High-strength concrete circular columns” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以試拌確認高強度混凝土的強度、彈性模數與工作性，施工中依批次取試體；柱的螺旋筋間距與保護層以現場量測抽查，並在澆置前檢查鋼筋籠是否留有足夠的混凝土通道，避免低坍度的高強度混凝土無法填實。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm strength, elastic modulus and workability of the high-strength mix in trial batches and sample by batch during construction; spot-check spiral pitch and cover on site, and check before each pour that the cage leaves enough passage for the concrete so a stiff high-strength mix can still compact fully. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：混凝土供應要有「配比－車號－澆置位置」的追蹤紀錄，高強度柱澆置前由監造確認送貨單上的配比編號；任何強度未達標的批次立即標示位置，並通知結構設計者評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep a mix–truck–location trace for every concrete delivery, with the resident engineer confirming the mix number on the delivery ticket before any high-strength column pour; mark the location of any batch that misses strength immediately and notify the structural designer for assessment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：箍筋或螺旋筋不足時，高強度混凝土柱在接近極限時會突然爆裂、延性很低；若用錯配比（低強度混凝土誤用於高強度柱），柱容量不足，只能拆除重做或以外包鋼板補強，對工期影響極大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: With too few ties or spirals, a high-strength concrete column bursts suddenly near its ultimate load with little ductility; if the wrong, lower-strength mix is placed in a high-strength column, capacity is short and the only remedies are demolition and recasting or steel jacketing, with severe schedule impact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 高強度混凝土圓柱的軸壓容量：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高強度混凝土圓柱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “High-strength concrete circular columns” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 箍筋或螺旋筋不足時，高強度混凝土柱在接近極限時會突然爆裂、延性很低；若用錯配比（低強度混凝土誤用於高強度柱），柱容量不足，只能拆除重做或以外包鋼板補強，對工期影響極大。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: With too few ties or spirals, a high-strength concrete column bursts suddenly near its ultimate load with little ductility; if the wrong, lower-strength mix is placed in a high-strength column, capacity is short and the only remedies are demolition and recasting or steel jacketing, with severe schedule impact. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：高強度混凝土讓柱斷面變小、可用樓地板增加，但材料較脆，需要較密的箍筋或螺旋筋提供圍束，才能在地震或意外超載時保有延性；其彈性模數、徐變與乾縮也與一般混凝土不同，影響柱與核心之間的差異縮短。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: High-strength concrete shrinks column sections and frees floor area, but it is more brittle and needs closely spaced ties or spirals for confinement to keep ductility in an earthquake or accidental overload; its elastic modulus, creep and shrinkage also differ from ordinary concrete, affecting differential shortening between columns and core.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「高強度混凝土比一般混凝土更有韌性，所以不需要額外圍束。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High-strength concrete is tougher than ordinary concrete, so it needs no extra confinement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 可隨兩塔移動的空橋：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: A skybridge that moves with two towers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「空橋雙鉸拱支腳」如何影響吉隆坡雙子星塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Skybridge two-hinged arch legs” governs force, deformation or durability in “Petronas Twin Towers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 兩座塔在第 41 與 42 層以兩層高的空橋相連，跨度約 58.4 m、離地約 170 m、重約 750 公噸。兩座塔在風中各自擺動，空橋若剛接在兩塔上就會被拉扯或擠壓；因此空橋由一對約 51 m 長的鋼管斜腳組成雙鉸拱，腳的下端以可轉動的支承固定在兩塔第 29 層，上端支承空橋，讓兩塔可以獨立移動。空橋端部與塔體之間也須留有滑動與轉動的空間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「空橋雙鉸拱支腳」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The towers are linked at levels 41 and 42 by a two-storey skybridge spanning about 58.4 m, about 170 m above ground and weighing about 750 t. Each tower sways independently in wind, so a skybridge rigidly fixed to both would be pulled and squeezed; instead it is carried by a pair of steel tube legs about 51 m long forming a two-hinged arch, seated on rotating bearings at level 29 of each tower and supporting the bridge at the top, so the towers can move independently. The bridge ends must also leave room for sliding and rotation against the towers. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Skybridge two-hinged arch legs” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：支腳轉角 θ = Δ/L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Leg rotation θ = Δ/L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「空橋把兩座塔連在一起，可以讓兩塔互相支撐、減少擺動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The skybridge ties the two towers together so they brace each other and sway less." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「空橋雙鉸拱支腳」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Skybridge two-hinged arch legs”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 可隨兩塔移動的空橋：定量估算
steps.titleEn: A skybridge that moves with two towers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「空橋雙鉸拱支腳」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Skybridge two-hinged arch legs” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：支腳轉角 θ = Δ/L。若兩塔在空橋高度各向相反方向移動 0.3 m，相對位移 0.6 m；長 51 m 的支腳下端支承須容許 θ ≈ 0.3/51 ≈ 0.0059 rad（約 0.34°），空橋端部伸縮裝置則須容許約 ±0.6 m 的相對變位。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Leg rotation θ = Δ/L. If the towers move 0.3 m in opposite directions at bridge level, the relative movement is 0.6 m; each 51 m leg's bearing must accept θ ≈ 0.3/51 ≈ 0.0059 rad (about 0.34°), and the bridge-end joints must accommodate about ±0.6 m of relative movement. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以兩塔的風洞與地震分析結果組合出空橋高度的相對位移包絡，確認支承轉角、伸縮裝置行程與淨空都有餘裕；支承出廠前做轉動與承載試驗，安裝後記錄初始位置作為日後比對基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Combine wind-tunnel and seismic results for both towers into an envelope of relative movement at bridge level, confirming margin in bearing rotation, joint travel and clearances; test bearings for rotation and load before delivery and record their initial positions after installation as a baseline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

If the towers move 0.3 m in opposite directions at bridge level, the relative movement is 0.6 m; each 51 m leg's bearing must accept θ ≈ 0.3/51 ≈ 0.0059 rad (about 0.34°), and the bridge-end joints must accommodate about ±0.6 m of relative movement. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 可隨兩塔移動的空橋：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「空橋雙鉸拱支腳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：空橋支承與伸縮裝置列入定期檢查清單，記錄每次強風或地震後的位移指示；任何在空橋端部增設的管線、裝修或招牌都必須保留可動空間，並經結構工程師核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Put skybridge bearings and expansion joints on the periodic inspection list, recording movement indicators after every strong wind or earthquake; any services, finishes or signs added at the bridge ends must preserve the movement gaps and be approved by the structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若支承轉動受阻或伸縮裝置行程不足，兩塔反向擺動時空橋與支腳會承受巨大的附加力，可能損壞支承或拉裂塔體的埋件；若空橋被設計成兩塔間的剛性連桿，也會改變兩塔的動力特性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

knowledge.textEn: Combine wind-tunnel and seismic results for both towers into an envelope of relative movement at bridge level, confirming margin in bearing rotation, joint travel and clearances; test bearings for rotation and load before delivery and record their initial positions after installation as a baseline.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 空橋支承與伸縮裝置列入定期檢查清單，記錄每次強風或地震後的位移指示；任何在空橋端部增設的管線、裝修或招牌都必須保留可動空間，並經結構工程師核可。
knowledge.textEn: Put skybridge bearings and expansion joints on the periodic inspection list, recording movement indicators after every strong wind or earthquake; any services, finishes or signs added at the bridge ends must preserve the movement gaps and be approved by the structural engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「可隨兩塔移動的空橋」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "A skybridge that moves with two towers"?
options: 以兩塔的風洞與地震分析結果組合出空橋高度的相對位移包絡，確認支承轉角、伸縮裝置行程與淨空都有餘裕。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
管中管系統中，外圈柱只負責重力，側力全由核心承擔。
optionsEn: Combine wind-tunnel and seismic results for both towers into an envelope of relative movement at bridge level, confirming margin in bearing rotation, joint travel and clearances.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
In a tube-in-tube system the outer columns carry only gravity and the core takes all lateral load.
quiz.explanation: 以兩塔的風洞與地震分析結果組合出空橋高度的相對位移包絡，確認支承轉角、伸縮裝置行程與淨空都有餘裕；支承出廠前做轉動與承載試驗，安裝後記錄初始位置作為日後比對基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Combine wind-tunnel and seismic results for both towers into an envelope of relative movement at bridge level, confirming margin in bearing rotation, joint travel and clearances; test bearings for rotation and load before delivery and record their initial positions after installation as a baseline. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 可隨兩塔移動的空橋：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: A skybridge that moves with two towers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「空橋雙鉸拱支腳」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Skybridge two-hinged arch legs” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若支承轉動受阻或伸縮裝置行程不足，兩塔反向擺動時空橋與支腳會承受巨大的附加力，可能損壞支承或拉裂塔體的埋件；若空橋被設計成兩塔間的剛性連桿，也會改變兩塔的動力特性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If bearings bind or joint travel is insufficient, out-of-phase tower sway imposes large extra forces on the bridge and legs, damaging bearings or tearing embeds out of the towers; designing the bridge as a rigid link between the towers would also alter their dynamic behaviour. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：空橋端部與塔體之間也須留有滑動與轉動的空間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The bridge ends must also leave room for sliding and rotation against the towers.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「空橋把兩座塔連在一起，可以讓兩塔互相支撐、減少擺動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The skybridge ties the two towers together so they brace each other and sway less." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「可隨兩塔移動的空橋」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "A skybridge that moves with two towers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若支承轉動受阻或伸縮裝置行程不足，兩塔反向擺動時空橋與支腳會承受巨大的附加力，可能損壞支承或拉裂塔體的埋件。
只要把樁打得夠深，地質條件的差異就不重要。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
If bearings bind or joint travel is insufficient, out-of-phase tower sway imposes large extra forces on the bridge and legs, damaging bearings or tearing embeds out of the towers.
If piles are driven deep enough, differences in ground conditions do not matter.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「避開石灰岩懸崖的塔位移動與深樁筏基」與「兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shifting the towers off a limestone cliff onto deep piles and rafts" and "Geometry control with two contractors building side by side": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 避開石灰岩懸崖的塔位移動與深樁筏基：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Shifting the towers off a limestone cliff onto deep piles and rafts: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「深樁與 4.6 m 筏基」如何影響吉隆坡雙子星塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deep piles and the 4.6 m raft” governs force, deformation or durability in “Petronas Twin Towers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 原定基地的鑽探顯示一半位於風化石灰岩、一半位於軟岩，地下岩面有如懸崖，若照原位置興建，兩側沉陷會明顯不同。設計團隊因此把塔位移動約 61 m，讓兩座塔完全坐落在軟岩上；每座塔以 104 支深 60 至 114 m 的混凝土樁支承，上方為厚約 4.6 m 的筏基，混凝土約 13,200 m³，連續澆置約 54 小時完成。樁長不同是為了配合岩面起伏，使各處沉陷趨於一致。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「深樁與 4.6 m 筏基」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Borings at the original site showed one half on weathered limestone and the other on soft rock, with the rock surface dropping like a cliff, so building in place would have produced markedly different settlement on the two sides. The design team moved the towers about 61 m so both sit entirely on soft rock; each tower rests on 104 concrete piles 60 to 114 m deep beneath a raft about 4.6 m thick, about 13,200 m³ of concrete placed continuously in about 54 hours. The varying pile lengths follow the undulating rock to even out settlement. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Deep piles and the 4.6 m raft” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：差異沉陷造成的傾斜 θ = Δs/B。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Tilt from differential settlement θ = Δs/B.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要把樁打得夠深，地質條件的差異就不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If piles are driven deep enough, differences in ground conditions do not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「深樁與 4.6 m 筏基」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Deep piles and the 4.6 m raft”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 避開石灰岩懸崖的塔位移動與深樁筏基
knowledge.titleEn: Shifting the towers off a limestone cliff onto deep piles and rafts
knowledge.text: 原定基地的鑽探顯示一半位於風化石灰岩、一半位於軟岩，地下岩面有如懸崖，若照原位置興建，兩側沉陷會明顯不同。設計團隊因此把塔位移動約 61 m，讓兩座塔完全坐落在軟岩上；每座塔以 104 支深 60 至 114 m 的混凝土樁支承，上方為厚約 4.6 m 的筏基，混凝土約 13,200 m³，連續澆置約 54 小時完成。
knowledge.textEn: Borings at the original site showed one half on weathered limestone and the other on soft rock, with the rock surface dropping like a cliff, so building in place would have produced markedly different settlement on the two sides. The design team moved the towers about 61 m so both sit entirely on soft rock; each tower rests on 104 concrete piles 60 to 114 m deep beneath a raft about 4.6 m thick, about 13,200 m³ of concrete placed continuously in about 54 hours.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要把樁打得夠深，地質條件的差異就不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If piles are driven deep enough, differences in ground conditions do not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「避開石灰岩懸崖的塔位移動與深樁筏基」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shifting the towers off a limestone cliff onto deep piles and rafts" is correct?
options: 只要把樁打得夠深，地質條件的差異就不重要。
兩座塔各自做到垂直，空橋自然就能對準。
原定基地的鑽探顯示一半位於風化石灰岩、一半位於軟岩，地下岩面有如懸崖，若照原位置興建，兩側沉陷會明顯不同。
optionsEn: If piles are driven deep enough, differences in ground conditions do not matter.
If each tower is built plumb on its own, the skybridge will automatically fit.

Borings at the original site showed one half on weathered limestone and the other on soft rock, with the rock surface dropping like a cliff, so building in place would have produced markedly different settlement on the two sides.
quiz.explanation: 原定基地的鑽探顯示一半位於風化石灰岩、一半位於軟岩，地下岩面有如懸崖，若照原位置興建，兩側沉陷會明顯不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Borings at the original site showed one half on weathered limestone and the other on soft rock, with the rock surface dropping like a cliff, so building in place would have produced markedly different settlement on the two sides. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 避開石灰岩懸崖的塔位移動與深樁筏基：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shifting the towers off a limestone cliff onto deep piles and rafts: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「深樁與 4.6 m 筏基」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deep piles and the 4.6 m raft” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：差異沉陷造成的傾斜 θ = Δs/B。若一側比另一側多沉陷 30 mm、塔寬約 46 m，θ = 30/46,000 ≈ 1/1,533；在 452 m 高的塔頂造成約 452×(30/46,000) ≈ 0.29 m 的水平偏移，並在柱與核心之間引起附加內力。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Tilt from differential settlement θ = Δs/B. If one side settles 30 mm more than the other across a tower about 46 m wide, θ = 30/46,000 ≈ 1/1,533, giving about 452×(30/46,000) ≈ 0.29 m of horizontal offset at the 452 m top, plus extra forces between columns and core. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以密集鑽探與地球物理探測繪出岩面與溶蝕帶分布，依此決定每支樁的長度；施工時記錄每支樁的實際入岩深度與澆置量，並以載重試驗確認摩擦樁承載；完工後持續監測筏基各角落的沉陷並與預測比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map the rock surface and solution zones with dense borings and geophysics to set each pile's length; during construction record each pile's actual rock penetration and concrete volume and confirm friction-pile capacity by load tests; after completion keep monitoring settlement at the raft corners against predictions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 差異沉陷造成的傾斜 θ = Δs/B。若一側比另一側多沉陷 30 mm、塔寬約 46 m，θ = 30/46,000 ≈ 1/1,533；在 452 m 高的塔頂造成約 452×(30/46,000) ≈ 0.29 m 的水平偏移，並在柱與核心之間引起附加內力。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Tilt from differential settlement θ = Δs/B. If one side settles 30 mm more than the other across a tower about 46 m wide, θ = 30/46,000 ≈ 1/1,533, giving about 452×(30/46,000) ≈ 0.29 m of horizontal offset at the 452 m top, plus extra forces between columns and core. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「避開石灰岩懸崖的塔位移動與深樁筏基」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shifting the towers off a limestone cliff onto deep piles and rafts", which statement holds?
options: 差異沉陷造成的傾斜 θ = Δs/B。
兩座相同的塔在風中會同步擺動，所以空橋不需要容許相對位移。
空橋是觀光設施，改裝不需要考慮避難與結構。
optionsEn: Tilt from differential settlement θ = Δs/B.
Two identical towers sway in step in the wind, so the skybridge needs no allowance for relative movement.
The skybridge is a visitor attraction, so alterations need not consider evacuation or structure.
quiz.explanation: 差異沉陷造成的傾斜 θ = Δs/B。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Tilt from differential settlement θ = Δs/B. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 避開石灰岩懸崖的塔位移動與深樁筏基：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shifting the towers off a limestone cliff onto deep piles and rafts: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「深樁與 4.6 m 筏基」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deep piles and the 4.6 m raft” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以密集鑽探與地球物理探測繪出岩面與溶蝕帶分布，依此決定每支樁的長度；施工時記錄每支樁的實際入岩深度與澆置量，並以載重試驗確認摩擦樁承載；完工後持續監測筏基各角落的沉陷並與預測比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map the rock surface and solution zones with dense borings and geophysics to set each pile's length; during construction record each pile's actual rock penetration and concrete volume and confirm friction-pile capacity by load tests; after completion keep monitoring settlement at the raft corners against predictions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：基礎設計前的地質調查要涵蓋整個塔位並延伸到可能的移位範圍，發現溶蝕或岩面陡變時，由大地顧問、結構設計者與業主共同決定是否調整塔位；筏基澆置須有不中斷供料的備援計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Site investigation before foundation design must cover the whole footprint and any possible shifted position; when solution features or steep rock surfaces are found, the geotechnical consultant, structural designer and owner decide together whether to move the tower, and the raft pour needs a backup plan for uninterrupted supply.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：喀斯特石灰岩中的溶洞若未被探測到，樁底可能落在空洞上方，承載與沉陷都無法預測；筏基若因供料中斷形成冷縫，承受巨大集中力的厚板可能在接縫處剪壞或滲水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Undetected cavities in karstic limestone can leave pile toes above voids, making capacity and settlement unpredictable; a cold joint caused by supply interruption in the raft can let a thick slab carrying huge concentrated loads fail in shear or leak at the joint. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以密集鑽探與地球物理探測繪出岩面與溶蝕帶分布，依此決定每支樁的長度；施工時記錄每支樁的實際入岩深度與澆置量，並以載重試驗確認摩擦樁承載；完工後持續監測筏基各角落的沉陷並與預測比對。
knowledge.textEn: Map the rock surface and solution zones with dense borings and geophysics to set each pile's length; during construction record each pile's actual rock penetration and concrete volume and confirm friction-pile capacity by load tests; after completion keep monitoring settlement at the raft corners against predictions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 基礎設計前的地質調查要涵蓋整個塔位並延伸到可能的移位範圍，發現溶蝕或岩面陡變時，由大地顧問、結構設計者與業主共同決定是否調整塔位；筏基澆置須有不中斷供料的備援計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Site investigation before foundation design must cover the whole footprint and any possible shifted position; when solution features or steep rock surfaces are found, the geotechnical consultant, structural designer and owner decide together whether to move the tower, and the raft pour needs a backup plan for uninterrupted supply.

quiz.question: 要驗證「避開石灰岩懸崖的塔位移動與深樁筏基」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shifting the towers off a limestone cliff onto deep piles and rafts"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以密集鑽探與地球物理探測繪出岩面與溶蝕帶分布，依此決定每支樁的長度。
建築越輕越好，重量對結構只有壞處。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Map the rock surface and solution zones with dense borings and geophysics to set each pile's length.
The lighter a building the better; weight is always bad for a structure.
quiz.explanation: 以密集鑽探與地球物理探測繪出岩面與溶蝕帶分布，依此決定每支樁的長度；施工時記錄每支樁的實際入岩深度與澆置量，並以載重試驗確認摩擦樁承載；完工後持續監測筏基各角落的沉陷並與預測比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map the rock surface and solution zones with dense borings and geophysics to set each pile's length; during construction record each pile's actual rock penetration and concrete volume and confirm friction-pile capacity by load tests; after completion keep monitoring settlement at the raft corners against predictions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 避開石灰岩懸崖的塔位移動與深樁筏基：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shifting the towers off a limestone cliff onto deep piles and rafts: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「深樁與 4.6 m 筏基」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deep piles and the 4.6 m raft” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 喀斯特石灰岩中的溶洞若未被探測到，樁底可能落在空洞上方，承載與沉陷都無法預測；筏基若因供料中斷形成冷縫，承受巨大集中力的厚板可能在接縫處剪壞或滲水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Undetected cavities in karstic limestone can leave pile toes above voids, making capacity and settlement unpredictable; a cold joint caused by supply interruption in the raft can let a thick slab carrying huge concentrated loads fail in shear or leak at the joint. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：樁長不同是為了配合岩面起伏，使各處沉陷趨於一致。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The varying pile lengths follow the undulating rock to even out settlement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要把樁打得夠深，地質條件的差異就不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If piles are driven deep enough, differences in ground conditions do not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「避開石灰岩懸崖的塔位移動與深樁筏基」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shifting the towers off a limestone cliff onto deep piles and rafts" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Geometry control with two contractors building side by side: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「雙承包商與垂直度」如何影響吉隆坡雙子星塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Two contractors and verticality” governs force, deformation or durability in “Petronas Twin Towers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 政府要求六年內完工，兩座塔因此分別由兩個承包團隊施工：塔一由間組領銜，塔二由三星物產領銜。兩塔的施工方法、測量團隊與進度各自獨立，但最後必須以同一座空橋準確相接，對兩塔在第 29 層與第 41、42 層的座標與高程要求一致。公開報導指出塔一施工到約 72 層時曾量得約 25 mm 的垂直偏差，之後以逐層微調修正；這類偏差若累積到空橋層，就會影響空橋支承的就位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「雙承包商與垂直度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The government required completion within six years, so the two towers were built by separate teams: Tower 1 led by Hazama and Tower 2 led by Samsung C&T. Their methods, survey teams and schedules ran independently, yet they had to meet a single skybridge precisely, demanding consistent coordinates and levels on both towers at level 29 and at levels 41 and 42. Public reports say Tower 1 was found about 25 mm out of plumb at around level 72 and corrected by small adjustments floor by floor; deviations of this kind accumulating at bridge level would disturb the seating of the bridge supports. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Two contractors and verticality” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：偏差修正率：若在約 72 層發現 25 mm 偏差，打算在其上 16 層內修正，每層平均修正 25/16 ≈ 1.6 mm；以約 300 m 高度計，25 mm 的傾角約 25/300,000 ≈ 1/12,000。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Correction rate: if a 25 mm deviation found at about level 72 is to be removed over the next 16 floors, the average correction is 25/16 ≈ 1.6 mm per floor; at a height of about 300 m, 25 mm corresponds to a tilt of about 25/300,000 ≈ 1/12,000.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩座塔各自做到垂直，空橋自然就能對準。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If each tower is built plumb on its own, the skybridge will automatically fit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「雙承包商與垂直度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Two contractors and verticality”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Geometry control with two contractors building side by side: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙承包商與垂直度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Two contractors and verticality” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：偏差修正率：若在約 72 層發現 25 mm 偏差，打算在其上 16 層內修正，每層平均修正 25/16 ≈ 1.6 mm；以約 300 m 高度計，25 mm 的傾角約 25/300,000 ≈ 1/12,000。修正量要小到不影響樓板與帷幕的接合。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Correction rate: if a 25 mm deviation found at about level 72 is to be removed over the next 16 floors, the average correction is 25/16 ≈ 1.6 mm per floor; at a height of about 300 m, 25 mm corresponds to a tilt of about 25/300,000 ≈ 1/12,000. Corrections must stay small enough not to upset slab and façade connections. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：兩塔共用同一套控制網與基準點，由獨立測量單位定期聯測兩塔關鍵樓層的座標與高程；空橋支承層施工前做一次聯合檢核，確認兩塔的相對位置符合空橋製造尺寸，否則先調整支承墊板設計。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run both towers from one control network and set of datums, with an independent survey team periodically tying in coordinates and levels on key floors of both; before the skybridge support levels are built, hold a joint check confirming that the towers' relative positions match the bridge's fabricated dimensions, otherwise redesign the bearing packs first.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Corrections must stay small enough not to upset slab and façade connections. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Geometry control with two contractors building side by side", which statement holds?
options: 不鏽鋼不會生鏽，所以外牆金屬件不需要維護。
偏差修正率：若在約 72 層發現 25 mm 偏差，打算在其上 16 層內修正，每層平均修正 25/16 ≈ 1.6 mm。
管中管系統中，外圈柱只負責重力，側力全由核心承擔。
optionsEn: Stainless steel never rusts, so façade metalwork needs no maintenance.
Correction rate: if a 25 mm deviation found at about level 72 is to be removed over the next 16 floors, the average correction is 25/16 ≈ 1.6 mm per floor.

quiz.explanation: 偏差修正率：若在約 72 層發現 25 mm 偏差，打算在其上 16 層內修正，每層平均修正 25/16 ≈ 1.6 mm；以約 300 m 高度計，25 mm 的傾角約 25/300,000 ≈ 1/12,000。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Geometry control with two contractors building side by side: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙承包商與垂直度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Two contractors and verticality” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 兩塔共用同一套控制網與基準點，由獨立測量單位定期聯測兩塔關鍵樓層的座標與高程；空橋支承層施工前做一次聯合檢核，確認兩塔的相對位置符合空橋製造尺寸，否則先調整支承墊板設計。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run both towers from one control network and set of datums, with an independent survey team periodically tying in coordinates and levels on key floors of both; before the skybridge support levels are built, hold a joint check confirming that the towers' relative positions match the bridge's fabricated dimensions, otherwise redesign the bearing packs first. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合約要明訂共同控制網、聯測頻率與容許偏差，關鍵樓層設置聯合簽認的停止點；任何修正計畫由兩塔的結構與測量負責人共同核可，並通知空橋製造商。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Contracts should specify a shared control network, tie-in frequency and tolerances, with jointly signed hold points at key floors; any correction plan is approved by the structural and survey leads of both towers and notified to the skybridge fabricator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩塔若各自使用不同的基準或座標轉換，誤差要到空橋吊裝時才被發現，只能在高空臨時修改支承或切割構件；逐層修正若過於急促，樓板邊緣與帷幕單元會出現階差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If each tower uses its own datum or coordinate transformation, the mismatch surfaces only when the skybridge is lifted, forcing makeshift changes to supports or cutting of members at height; corrections made too abruptly leave steps at slab edges and curtain-wall units. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 兩塔共用同一套控制網與基準點，由獨立測量單位定期聯測兩塔關鍵樓層的座標與高程；空橋支承層施工前做一次聯合檢核，確認兩塔的相對位置符合空橋製造尺寸，否則先調整支承墊板設計。
knowledge.textEn: Run both towers from one control network and set of datums, with an independent survey team periodically tying in coordinates and levels on key floors of both; before the skybridge support levels are built, hold a joint check confirming that the towers' relative positions match the bridge's fabricated dimensions, otherwise redesign the bearing packs first.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 合約要明訂共同控制網、聯測頻率與容許偏差，關鍵樓層設置聯合簽認的停止點；任何修正計畫由兩塔的結構與測量負責人共同核可，並通知空橋製造商。
knowledge.textEn: Contracts should specify a shared control network, tie-in frequency and tolerances, with jointly signed hold points at key floors; any correction plan is approved by the structural and survey leads of both towers and notified to the skybridge fabricator.

quiz.question: 要驗證「兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Geometry control with two contractors building side by side"?

高強度混凝土比一般混凝土更有韌性，所以不需要額外圍束。
兩塔共用同一套控制網與基準點，由獨立測量單位定期聯測兩塔關鍵樓層的座標與高程。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
High-strength concrete is tougher than ordinary concrete, so it needs no extra confinement.
Run both towers from one control network and set of datums, with an independent survey team periodically tying in coordinates and levels on key floors of both.
quiz.explanation: 兩塔共用同一套控制網與基準點，由獨立測量單位定期聯測兩塔關鍵樓層的座標與高程；空橋支承層施工前做一次聯合檢核，確認兩塔的相對位置符合空橋製造尺寸，否則先調整支承墊板設計。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run both towers from one control network and set of datums, with an independent survey team periodically tying in coordinates and levels on key floors of both; before the skybridge support levels are built, hold a joint check confirming that the towers' relative positions match the bridge's fabricated dimensions, otherwise redesign the bearing packs first. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Geometry control with two contractors building side by side: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙承包商與垂直度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Two contractors and verticality” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩塔若各自使用不同的基準或座標轉換，誤差要到空橋吊裝時才被發現，只能在高空臨時修改支承或切割構件；逐層修正若過於急促，樓板邊緣與帷幕單元會出現階差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If each tower uses its own datum or coordinate transformation, the mismatch surfaces only when the skybridge is lifted, forcing makeshift changes to supports or cutting of members at height; corrections made too abruptly leave steps at slab edges and curtain-wall units. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：公開報導指出塔一施工到約 72 層時曾量得約 25 mm 的垂直偏差，之後以逐層微調修正；這類偏差若累積到空橋層，就會影響空橋支承的就位。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Public reports say Tower 1 was found about 25 mm out of plumb at around level 72 and corrected by small adjustments floor by floor; deviations of this kind accumulating at bridge level would disturb the seating of the bridge supports.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩座塔各自做到垂直，空橋自然就能對準。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If each tower is built plumb on its own, the skybridge will automatically fit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 兩塔若各自使用不同的基準或座標轉換，誤差要到空橋吊裝時才被發現，只能在高空臨時修改支承或切割構件；逐層修正若過於急促，樓板邊緣與帷幕單元會出現階差。
