knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Geometry control with two contractors building side by side" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 兩塔若各自使用不同的基準或座標轉換，誤差要到空橋吊裝時才被發現，只能在高空臨時修改支承或切割構件；逐層修正若過於急促，樓板邊緣與帷幕單元會出現階差。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要大多數試體合格，偶爾幾組不合格可以忽略。
optionsEn: If each tower uses its own datum or coordinate transformation, the mismatch surfaces only when the skybridge is lifted, forcing makeshift changes to supports or cutting of members at height.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If most specimens pass, an occasional failing set can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 兩塔若各自使用不同的基準或座標轉換，誤差要到空橋吊裝時才被發現，只能在高空臨時修改支承或切割構件；逐層修正若過於急促，樓板邊緣與帷幕單元會出現階差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If each tower uses its own datum or coordinate transformation, the mismatch surfaces only when the skybridge is lifted, forcing makeshift changes to supports or cutting of members at height; corrections made too abruptly leave steps at slab edges and curtain-wall units. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高強度混凝土的驗收與不合格處理」與「風洞試驗與雙塔干擾效應」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Acceptance of high-strength concrete and handling non-conformance" and "Wind-tunnel testing and twin-tower interference": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高強度混凝土的驗收與不合格處理：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Acceptance of high-strength concrete and handling non-conformance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「混凝土強度驗收」如何影響吉隆坡雙子星塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concrete strength acceptance” governs force, deformation or durability in “Petronas Twin Towers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 以高強度混凝土為主要材料的超高層，整棟樓的安全建立在每一車混凝土的品質上。驗收依統計原則：單一試體偶有偏低是正常變異，但連續數組的平均值不足或單組過低，就代表供料或施工有系統性問題。不合格時的處理順序是先確認試體本身是否有問題，再以鑽心取樣評估結構內的實際強度，最後才由設計者判斷補強或拆除。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「混凝土強度驗收」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a supertall tower built mainly of high-strength concrete, the safety of the whole building rests on the quality of every truckload. Acceptance follows statistical rules: an occasional low specimen is normal variation, but a low running average or a single very low set signals a systematic problem in supply or placement. When results fail, the order is to check the specimens themselves first, then assess in-place strength by coring, and only then have the designer decide between strengthening and demolition. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Concrete strength acceptance” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ACI 318 對 f'c > 35 MPa 的準則：連續三組平均 ≥ f'c，且單組 ≥ 0.90f'c。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Using the ACI 318 criteria for f'c above 35 MPa, every average of three consecutive tests must be ≥ f'c and no single test below 0.90f'c.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要大多數試體合格，偶爾幾組不合格可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If most specimens pass, an occasional failing set can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「混凝土強度驗收」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Concrete strength acceptance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高強度混凝土的驗收與不合格處理
knowledge.titleEn: Acceptance of high-strength concrete and handling non-conformance
knowledge.text: 以高強度混凝土為主要材料的超高層，整棟樓的安全建立在每一車混凝土的品質上。驗收依統計原則：單一試體偶有偏低是正常變異，但連續數組的平均值不足或單組過低，就代表供料或施工有系統性問題。
knowledge.textEn: In a supertall tower built mainly of high-strength concrete, the safety of the whole building rests on the quality of every truckload. Acceptance follows statistical rules: an occasional low specimen is normal variation, but a low running average or a single very low set signals a systematic problem in supply or placement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要大多數試體合格，偶爾幾組不合格可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If most specimens pass, an occasional failing set can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高強度混凝土的驗收與不合格處理」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Acceptance of high-strength concrete and handling non-conformance" is correct?
options: 只要大多數試體合格，偶爾幾組不合格可以忽略。
以高強度混凝土為主要材料的超高層，整棟樓的安全建立在每一車混凝土的品質上。
兩座相同的塔在風中會同步擺動，所以空橋不需要容許相對位移。
optionsEn: If most specimens pass, an occasional failing set can be ignored.
In a supertall tower built mainly of high-strength concrete, the safety of the whole building rests on the quality of every truckload.
Two identical towers sway in step in the wind, so the skybridge needs no allowance for relative movement.
quiz.explanation: 以高強度混凝土為主要材料的超高層，整棟樓的安全建立在每一車混凝土的品質上。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In a supertall tower built mainly of high-strength concrete, the safety of the whole building rests on the quality of every truckload. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高強度混凝土的驗收與不合格處理：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Acceptance of high-strength concrete and handling non-conformance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「混凝土強度驗收」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Concrete strength acceptance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ACI 318 對 f'c > 35 MPa 的準則：連續三組平均 ≥ f'c，且單組 ≥ 0.90f'c。f'c = 80 MPa 時，84、78、79 MPa 的平均 80.3 MPa、最低 78 ≥ 72，合格；82、74、76 MPa 的平均 77.3 MPa 不合格，須鑽心評估（三個鑽心平均 ≥ 0.85f'c = 68 MPa 且單一 ≥ 0.75f'c = 60 MPa）。試驗數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Using the ACI 318 criteria for f'c above 35 MPa, every average of three consecutive tests must be ≥ f'c and no single test below 0.90f'c. With f'c = 80 MPa, tests of 84, 78 and 79 MPa average 80.3 MPa with a minimum of 78 ≥ 72 and pass; 82, 74 and 76 MPa average 77.3 MPa and fail, requiring cores (three cores averaging ≥ 0.85f'c = 68 MPa with none below 0.75f'c = 60 MPa). Test values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立試體取樣、養護與試驗的追溯流程，每組試體對應澆置位置；不合格時先檢查試體養護與試驗紀錄，再於該位置鑽心並輔以非破壞檢測，結果送設計者評估，必要時以載重試驗確認。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Set up a traceable sampling, curing and testing procedure with every set linked to its placement location; on failure check specimen curing and test records first, then core the location with supporting non-destructive tests and send the results to the designer, confirming by load testing where needed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ACI 318 對 f'c > 35 MPa 的準則：連續三組平均 ≥ f'c，且單組 ≥ 0.90f'c。f'c = 80 MPa 時，84、78、79 MPa 的平均 80.3 MPa、最低 78 ≥ 72，合格；82、74、76 MPa 的平均 77.3 MPa 不合格，須鑽心評估（三個鑽心平均 ≥ 0.85f'c = 68 MPa 且單一 ≥ 0.75f'c = 60 MPa）。試驗數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Using the ACI 318 criteria for f'c above 35 MPa, every average of three consecutive tests must be ≥ f'c and no single test below 0.90f'c. With f'c = 80 MPa, tests of 84, 78 and 79 MPa average 80.3 MPa with a minimum of 78 ≥ 72 and pass; 82, 74 and 76 MPa average 77.3 MPa and fail, requiring cores (three cores averaging ≥ 0.85f'c = 68 MPa with none below 0.75f'c = 60 MPa). Test values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高強度混凝土的驗收與不合格處理」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Acceptance of high-strength concrete and handling non-conformance", which statement holds?
options: 空橋是觀光設施，改裝不需要考慮避難與結構。
建築越輕越好，重量對結構只有壞處。
ACI 318 對 f'c > 35 MPa 的準則：連續三組平均 ≥ f'c，且單組 ≥ 0.90f'c。
optionsEn: The skybridge is a visitor attraction, so alterations need not consider evacuation or structure.
The lighter a building the better; weight is always bad for a structure.
Using the ACI 318 criteria for f'c above 35 MPa, every average of three consecutive tests must be ≥ f'c and no single test below 0.90f'c.
quiz.explanation: ACI 318 對 f'c > 35 MPa 的準則：連續三組平均 ≥ f'c，且單組 ≥ 0.90f'c。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Using the ACI 318 criteria for f'c above 35 MPa, every average of three consecutive tests must be ≥ f'c and no single test below 0.90f'c. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高強度混凝土的驗收與不合格處理：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Acceptance of high-strength concrete and handling non-conformance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「混凝土強度驗收」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Concrete strength acceptance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立試體取樣、養護與試驗的追溯流程，每組試體對應澆置位置；不合格時先檢查試體養護與試驗紀錄，再於該位置鑽心並輔以非破壞檢測，結果送設計者評估，必要時以載重試驗確認。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Set up a traceable sampling, curing and testing procedure with every set linked to its placement location; on failure check specimen curing and test records first, then core the location with supporting non-destructive tests and send the results to the designer, confirming by load testing where needed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：品質計畫要訂出「試體不合格即停止在其上方施工」的停止點，直到設計者完成評估；配比、供料廠與試驗室資料按日彙整，趨勢下滑時提前介入。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The quality plan sets a hold point that stops work above any failing location until the designer completes the assessment; compile mix, plant and laboratory data daily and intervene early when trends slip.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若驗收只看單組結果而忽略連續平均，供料品質的緩慢下滑可能到多層樓完成後才被發現；不合格樓板或柱若未及時處理，上方繼續施工會增加荷重，使補救更困難，最後只能拆除重做。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Judging only single results and ignoring running averages can hide a slow decline in supply quality until many floors are complete; if non-conforming slabs or columns are not dealt with promptly, work above adds load and makes repair harder, until demolition and recasting are the only option. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 風洞試驗與雙塔干擾效應：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wind-tunnel testing and twin-tower interference: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「兩塔相對位移的統計組合」如何影響吉隆坡雙子星塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Statistical combination of relative movement” governs force, deformation or durability in “Petronas Twin Towers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 兩座相同的塔並列時，風經過上游塔產生的尾流會衝擊下游塔，造成比單塔更大的擾動，稱為干擾效應；同時空橋要承受的不是單塔位移，而是兩塔在同一時刻的相對位移。兩塔的運動部分相關、部分獨立：完全同步時相對位移為零，完全反向時最大。風洞試驗必須同時放置兩座塔的模型，量測各風向下兩塔的位移時程，再以統計方法求出相對位移的設計值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「兩塔相對位移的統計組合」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When two identical towers stand side by side, the wake from the upwind tower buffets the downwind one, causing more disturbance than for a single tower, known as interference; meanwhile the skybridge must accept not single-tower movement but the two towers' simultaneous relative movement. Their motions are partly correlated and partly independent: in perfect step the relative movement is zero, in exact opposition it is greatest. The wind tunnel must model both towers together, record their displacement histories for each wind direction and derive the design relative movement statistically. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Statistical combination of relative movement” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：相對位移標準差 σ_rel = √(σ₁² + σ₂² − 2ρσ₁σ₂)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Relative-displacement standard deviation σ_rel = √(σ₁² + σ₂² − 2ρσ₁σ₂).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩座相同的塔在風中會同步擺動，所以空橋不需要容許相對位移。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 風洞試驗與雙塔干擾效應：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「兩塔相對位移的統計組合」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Statistical combination of relative movement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：相對位移標準差 σ_rel = √(σ₁² + σ₂² − 2ρσ₁σ₂)。σ₁ = σ₂ = 0.15 m：相關係數 ρ = 0.3 時 σ_rel ≈ 0.177 m，乘以尖峰因子 3.5 得約 0.62 m；ρ = 0 時約 0.74 m；完全反向 ρ = −1 時約 1.05 m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Relative-displacement standard deviation σ_rel = √(σ₁² + σ₂² − 2ρσ₁σ₂). With σ₁ = σ₂ = 0.15 m, a correlation ρ = 0.3 gives σ_rel ≈ 0.177 m and, with a peak factor of 3.5, about 0.62 m; ρ = 0 gives about 0.74 m and fully opposed motion, ρ = −1, about 1.05 m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：雙塔模型同時裝設位移或加速度量測，取得同步時程並計算各風向的相關係數；設計值取最不利風向的相對位移，並與單塔結果直接相加的保守估算比較，確認空橋支承與伸縮裝置的行程足夠。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Instrument both models simultaneously for displacement or acceleration, obtain synchronised histories and compute the correlation for each wind direction; take the design value from the worst direction's relative movement, compare it with the conservative estimate of simply adding single-tower results, and confirm the skybridge bearings and joints have enough travel.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.instruction: 雙塔模型同時裝設位移或加速度量測，取得同步時程並計算各風向的相關係數；設計值取最不利風向的相對位移，並與單塔結果直接相加的保守估算比較，確認空橋支承與伸縮裝置的行程足夠。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：風洞試驗範圍要明列雙塔干擾與相對位移的輸出項目；完工後在兩塔空橋層附近設置同步加速度計，強風事件後比對實測相對位移與設計值，偏差大時通知結構顧問。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只用單塔風洞資料，下游塔受尾流衝擊的放大與兩塔反向擺動的機率都會被忽略，空橋端部的伸縮裝置可能在強風時碰到行程極限，損壞裝置並讓空橋承受衝擊力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using single-tower data alone ignores the amplification on the downwind tower from wake buffeting and the chance of opposed sway, so bridge-end joints can hit their travel limits in strong winds, damaging the joints and subjecting the bridge to impact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 雙塔模型同時裝設位移或加速度量測，取得同步時程並計算各風向的相關係數；設計值取最不利風向的相對位移，並與單塔結果直接相加的保守估算比較，確認空橋支承與伸縮裝置的行程足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Instrument both models simultaneously for displacement or acceleration, obtain synchronised histories and compute the correlation for each wind direction; take the design value from the worst direction's relative movement, compare it with the conservative estimate of simply adding single-tower results, and confirm the skybridge bearings and joints have enough travel.

steps.title: 風洞試驗與雙塔干擾效應：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wind-tunnel testing and twin-tower interference: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「兩塔相對位移的統計組合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Statistical combination of relative movement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只用單塔風洞資料，下游塔受尾流衝擊的放大與兩塔反向擺動的機率都會被忽略，空橋端部的伸縮裝置可能在強風時碰到行程極限，損壞裝置並讓空橋承受衝擊力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using single-tower data alone ignores the amplification on the downwind tower from wake buffeting and the chance of opposed sway, so bridge-end joints can hit their travel limits in strong winds, damaging the joints and subjecting the bridge to impact. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩座相同的塔在風中會同步擺動，所以空橋不需要容許相對位移。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two identical towers sway in step in the wind, so the skybridge needs no allowance for relative movement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「不鏽鋼與玻璃外牆」如何影響吉隆坡雙子星塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stainless-steel and glass façade” governs force, deformation or durability in “Petronas Twin Towers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙子星塔的外牆以不鏽鋼與玻璃為主，在吉隆坡終年高溫、強烈日照與熱帶暴雨下運作。不鏽鋼的熱膨脹係數比玻璃與混凝土大，日照時外露金屬升溫快，三種材料的伸縮差會集中在接縫、密封膠與固定件上；暴雨與高濕度則考驗排水與防水設計。外牆的長期維護包括密封膠更換、固定件腐蝕檢查與玻璃破損更換，都需要能到達每一處的外牆維護設備。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「不鏽鋼與玻璃外牆」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Petronas façade is mainly stainless steel and glass, working year-round in Kuala Lumpur's heat, strong sun and tropical downpours. Stainless steel expands more with heat than glass or concrete, and exposed metal heats quickly in sunshine, so the differential movement of the three materials concentrates at joints, sealants and fixings, while heavy rain and humidity test drainage and waterproofing. Long-term upkeep includes sealant replacement, fixing corrosion checks and broken-glass replacement, all requiring access equipment that can reach every part of the façade. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Stainless-steel and glass façade” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：熱脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「不鏽鋼不會生鏽，所以外牆金屬件不需要維護。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「不鏽鋼與玻璃外牆」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stainless-steel and glass façade” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：熱脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。4 m 長的構件、溫升 50 °C：沃斯田鐵系不鏽鋼 α = 17×10⁻⁶ /°C，ΔL = 17×10⁻⁶×4,000×50 = 3.4 mm；玻璃 α = 9×10⁻⁶ /°C，ΔL = 1.8 mm；兩者相差 1.6 mm，須由接縫與密封膠吸收。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT. For a 4 m member heating by 50 °C, austenitic stainless steel with α = 17×10⁻⁶ /°C grows ΔL = 17×10⁻⁶×4,000×50 = 3.4 mm, while glass with α = 9×10⁻⁶ /°C grows 1.8 mm; the 1.6 mm difference must be taken up by joints and sealant. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以實尺寸試體做熱循環、水密與氣密試驗，確認接縫在反覆伸縮下不漏水；營運中定期檢查密封膠的硬化與龜裂、不鏽鋼與碳鋼固定件接觸處的電位腐蝕，以及排水孔是否阻塞。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test full-scale specimens under thermal cycling, water and air tightness to confirm joints stay watertight through repeated movement; in service inspect regularly for sealant hardening and cracking, galvanic corrosion where stainless steel contacts carbon-steel fixings, and blocked drainage holes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 熱脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。4 m 長的構件、溫升 50 °C：沃斯田鐵系不鏽鋼 α = 17×10⁻⁶ /°C，ΔL = 17×10⁻⁶×4,000×50 = 3.4 mm；玻璃 α = 9×10⁻⁶ /°C，ΔL = 1.8 mm；兩者相差 1.6 mm，須由接縫與密封膠吸收。數值為教學假設。

For a 4 m member heating by 50 °C, austenitic stainless steel with α = 17×10⁻⁶ /°C grows ΔL = 17×10⁻⁶×4,000×50 = 3.4 mm, while glass with α = 9×10⁻⁶ /°C grows 1.8 mm; the 1.6 mm difference must be taken up by joints and sealant. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate", which statement holds?
options: 建築越輕越好，重量對結構只有壞處。
熱脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
空橋把兩座塔連在一起，可以讓兩塔互相支撐、減少擺動。

steps.title: 熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「不鏽鋼與玻璃外牆」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stainless-steel and glass façade” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以實尺寸試體做熱循環、水密與氣密試驗，確認接縫在反覆伸縮下不漏水；營運中定期檢查密封膠的硬化與龜裂、不鏽鋼與碳鋼固定件接觸處的電位腐蝕，以及排水孔是否阻塞。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test full-scale specimens under thermal cycling, water and air tightness to confirm joints stay watertight through repeated movement; in service inspect regularly for sealant hardening and cracking, galvanic corrosion where stainless steel contacts carbon-steel fixings, and blocked drainage holes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件列出外牆材料的熱脹設計值、接縫容許變形、密封膠更換週期與異種金屬絕緣細部；維護紀錄依立面與樓層編號管理，方便追蹤重複發生的漏水點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents list the design thermal movements of façade materials, allowable joint deformation, sealant replacement intervals and dissimilar-metal isolation details; organise maintenance records by elevation and floor to track recurring leaks.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若接縫寬度只按玻璃的熱脹設計，不鏽鋼伸長會擠壓密封膠並造成脫膠，雨水滲入後腐蝕固定件；不同金屬直接接觸而未絕緣，在潮濕環境下的電位腐蝕會削弱固定件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sizing joints only for glass expansion lets the stainless steel squeeze and debond the sealant, admitting rain that corrodes the fixings; dissimilar metals in direct contact without isolation suffer galvanic corrosion in the humid climate, weakening the fixings. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「不鏽鋼與玻璃外牆」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 若接縫寬度只按玻璃的熱脹設計，不鏽鋼伸長會擠壓密封膠並造成脫膠，雨水滲入後腐蝕固定件；不同金屬直接接觸而未絕緣，在潮濕環境下的電位腐蝕會削弱固定件。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.title: 空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「空橋避難路徑」如何影響吉隆坡雙子星塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Skybridge escape route” governs force, deformation or durability in “Petronas Twin Towers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙子星塔的空橋不只是觀光設施，也是火災避難策略的一部分：一座塔發生緊急狀況時，上層人員可經空橋疏散到另一座塔，再由另一座塔的樓梯或電梯離開。這使空橋的結構、支承、防火與通道淨寬都成為生命安全系統，必須在整個建築壽命中保持可用。任何改裝（例如增設展示、管線或改變出入口）都要確認不會縮減淨寬、阻礙門扇或侵入空橋的可動空間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「空橋避難路徑」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Petronas skybridge is not just an attraction but part of the fire-evacuation strategy: in an emergency in one tower, occupants of the upper floors can cross to the other tower and leave by its stairs or lifts. That makes the bridge's structure, bearings, fire protection and clear width parts of a life-safety system that must remain available throughout the building's life. Any alteration, such as added displays, services or changed entrances, must be checked so it does not reduce clear width, obstruct doors or encroach on the bridge's movement gaps. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Skybridge escape route” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：通行能力 = 淨寬 × 單位流率。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Capacity = clear width × unit flow rate.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「空橋是觀光設施，改裝不需要考慮避難與結構。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The skybridge is a visitor attraction, so alterations need not consider evacuation or structure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「空橋避難路徑」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「空橋避難路徑」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Skybridge escape route” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：通行能力 = 淨寬 × 單位流率。淨寬 2.4 m、流率 1.3 人/(m·s) 時約 3.1 人/秒；若需疏散 10,000 人，約需 10,000/3.12 ≈ 3,205 s，約 53 分鐘。淨寬若因改裝減為 1.8 m，時間增為約 71 分鐘。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Capacity = clear width × unit flow rate. A 2.4 m clear width at 1.3 persons per metre per second passes about 3.1 persons per second, so evacuating 10,000 people takes about 10,000/3.12 ≈ 3,205 s, about 53 minutes. If an alteration narrows the width to 1.8 m, the time rises to about 71 minutes. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期做避難演練並記錄實際通過時間，與設計值比較；空橋支承、伸縮裝置與防火門每年檢查，並在強風或地震後檢查位移指示，以及門扇是否變形卡住。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Hold regular evacuation drills, recording actual crossing times against the design values; inspect bridge bearings, expansion joints and fire doors annually, and after strong winds or earthquakes check movement indicators and whether door leaves have distorted and jammed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

A 2.4 m clear width at 1.3 persons per metre per second passes about 3.1 persons per second, so evacuating 10,000 people takes about 10,000/3.12 ≈ 3,205 s, about 53 minutes. If an alteration narrows the width to 1.8 m, the time rises to about 71 minutes. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「空橋避難路徑」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Skybridge escape route” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期做避難演練並記錄實際通過時間，與設計值比較；空橋支承、伸縮裝置與防火門每年檢查，並在強風或地震後檢查位移指示，以及門扇是否變形卡住。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Hold regular evacuation drills, recording actual crossing times against the design values; inspect bridge bearings, expansion joints and fire doors annually, and after strong winds or earthquakes check movement indicators and whether door leaves have distorted and jammed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件把空橋列為生命安全與結構雙重管制的設施，附上淨寬、可動空間、支承規格與檢查表；任何改裝申請須同時經消防與結構審查，並更新避難計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents designate the skybridge as a facility under both life-safety and structural control, with clear widths, movement gaps, bearing specifications and inspection checklists; every alteration request needs both fire and structural review and an updated evacuation plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若改裝縮減了淨寬或在可動接縫上加裝固定物，緊急時疏散時間延長，強風時接縫被卡住還會損壞空橋；防火門因塔體相對位移而變形卡住，會讓避難路徑在最需要時失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Alterations that narrow the width or fix items across movement joints lengthen evacuation time and, in strong winds, jam the joints and damage the bridge; fire doors distorted and jammed by relative tower movement can defeat the escape route exactly when it is needed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 定期做避難演練並記錄實際通過時間，與設計值比較；空橋支承、伸縮裝置與防火門每年檢查，並在強風或地震後檢查位移指示，以及門扇是否變形卡住。
knowledge.textEn: Hold regular evacuation drills, recording actual crossing times against the design values; inspect bridge bearings, expansion joints and fire doors annually, and after strong winds or earthquakes check movement indicators and whether door leaves have distorted and jammed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件把空橋列為生命安全與結構雙重管制的設施，附上淨寬、可動空間、支承規格與檢查表；任何改裝申請須同時經消防與結構審查，並更新避難計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Handover documents designate the skybridge as a facility under both life-safety and structural control, with clear widths, movement gaps, bearing specifications and inspection checklists; every alteration request needs both fire and structural review and an updated evacuation plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route"?
options: 定期做避難演練並記錄實際通過時間，與設計值比較；空橋支承、伸縮裝置與防火門每年檢查，並在強風或地震後檢查位移指示，以及門扇是否變形卡住。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要大多數試體合格，偶爾幾組不合格可以忽略。
optionsEn: Hold regular evacuation drills, recording actual crossing times against the design values.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If most specimens pass, an occasional failing set can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 定期做避難演練並記錄實際通過時間，與設計值比較；空橋支承、伸縮裝置與防火門每年檢查，並在強風或地震後檢查位移指示，以及門扇是否變形卡住。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Hold regular evacuation drills, recording actual crossing times against the design values; inspect bridge bearings, expansion joints and fire doors annually, and after strong winds or earthquakes check movement indicators and whether door leaves have distorted and jammed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「空橋避難路徑」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Skybridge escape route” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若改裝縮減了淨寬或在可動接縫上加裝固定物，緊急時疏散時間延長，強風時接縫被卡住還會損壞空橋；防火門因塔體相對位移而變形卡住，會讓避難路徑在最需要時失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Alterations that narrow the width or fix items across movement joints lengthen evacuation time and, in strong winds, jam the joints and damage the bridge; fire doors distorted and jammed by relative tower movement can defeat the escape route exactly when it is needed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：任何改裝（例如增設展示、管線或改變出入口）都要確認不會縮減淨寬、阻礙門扇或侵入空橋的可動空間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Any alteration, such as added displays, services or changed entrances, must be checked so it does not reduce clear width, obstruct doors or encroach on the bridge's movement gaps.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「空橋是觀光設施，改裝不需要考慮避難與結構。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The skybridge is a visitor attraction, so alterations need not consider evacuation or structure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若改裝縮減了淨寬或在可動接縫上加裝固定物，緊急時疏散時間延長，強風時接縫被卡住還會損壞空橋；防火門因塔體相對位移而變形卡住，會讓避難路徑在最需要時失效。
knowledge.textEn: Alterations that narrow the width or fix items across movement joints lengthen evacuation time and, in strong winds, jam the joints and damage the bridge; fire doors distorted and jammed by relative tower movement can defeat the escape route exactly when it is needed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若改裝縮減了淨寬或在可動接縫上加裝固定物，緊急時疏散時間延長，強風時接縫被卡住還會損壞空橋；防火門因塔體相對位移而變形卡住，會讓避難路徑在最需要時失效。
管中管系統中，外圈柱只負責重力，側力全由核心承擔。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Alterations that narrow the width or fix items across movement joints lengthen evacuation time and, in strong winds, jam the joints and damage the bridge.
In a tube-in-tube system the outer columns carry only gravity and the core takes all lateral load.
quiz.explanation: 若改裝縮減了淨寬或在可動接縫上加裝固定物，緊急時疏散時間延長，強風時接縫被卡住還會損壞空橋；防火門因塔體相對位移而變形卡住，會讓避難路徑在最需要時失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Alterations that narrow the width or fix items across movement joints lengthen evacuation time and, in strong winds, jam the joints and damage the bridge; fire doors distorted and jammed by relative tower movement can defeat the escape route exactly when it is needed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
